description.text:
As an image processing embedded software engineer, you'll write descriptive, agile and testable code. You take inspiration from concepts like clean-code and the SOLID principles.
Involved in all stages of the software life cycle, your contribution spans from improving customer experience to streamlining the build process. You are keen to learn about the image-processing domain and its evolution.
You'll drive innovation and excellence in your specialized areas. Your creativity will be instrumental in realizing novel concepts and contributing to the successful release of imaging firmware for diverse camera products.
